Where this race stands
Verified

Republican Gov. Greg Abbott faces Democrat Gina Hinojosa in the Texas gubernatorial election on November 3, 2026. The race is rated Lean Republican, and the polling-derived margin gives Abbott a 3.1-point edge. Two of the latest polls ended fieldwork on October 23. Verasight showed Abbott leading 48% to 46% among 601 likely voters [1], and Texas Public Opinion Research had him ahead 51% to 48% among 969 likely voters [2]. On prediction markets, Polymarket gives Abbott a 68.9% chance of winning and Hinojosa 30.5% [6]. Kalshi prices Abbott at 67% and Hinojosa at 35% [7].
